channel.title: Flog It!
channel.desc: The pavilion in the charming seaside town of Exmouth in Devon is full of people waiting for valuations. Paul Martin, falls in love with a Newlyn Copper vase, while expert Will Axon spots a bronze sensor bowl and gold rings. Elsewhere, Christina Trevanion enthuses about a silver frame. Also down in Devon, Paul goes for a journey with a difference - a tram ride alongside the river Axe.
